last.verdict: Profit beat, but U.S. sales growth nearly stalled and customers are ordering less.

reasons.label: Stalled U.S. sales
reasons.text: U.S. same-store sales rose only 0.3%, versus 5.2% a year earlier.

reasons.label: Smaller orders
reasons.text: New CEO said budget-stretched customers order fewer items per order, and pressure should last through year-end.

reasons.label: Weak full-year outlook
reasons.text: U.S. sales growth now seen at the low end of low-single digits; international roughly flat.

story: Domino's U.S. sales growth has faded from 3.7% in late 2025 to 0.3% now. A first-quarter miss and a cut to the 2026 outlook sent shares down as much as 11%. A July rebound did not last, and a new CEO now faces weak spending.
